Highlights at a glance
Ultra-Compact Articulated Design :Mini Loader features a high-strength articulated frame, offering a tight turning radius for effortless navigation in narrow barn aisles, garden paths, and crowded Construction Machinery sites.
Reinforced Manganese Steel Chassis : Built for durability, the heavy-duty chassis resists deformation under full load, ensuring long-term reliability for professional contractors and farm owners in all terrain conditions.
30s Multi-Attachment Quick Hitch :Switch between bucket, forks, and grapples in seconds. This Compact Loader adapts instantly to farming, landscaping, and warehouse tasks, maximizing your machine's utility and ROI.
Dual-Pump Hydraulic Synergy System : Engineered for the 1.2t-2t range, our Wheel Loader ensures smooth, simultaneous lifting and steering, providing professional-grade efficiency even in high-frequency material handling scenarios.
Eco-Friendly Performance & Easy Access :Optional Euro 5/EPA engines for global compliance. The large-angle rear hood design allows for ground-level maintenance, significantly reducing downtime for this Articulated Loader.
Shandong Hengwang Group was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Jining, Shandong Province. After more than ten years of steady development, it has grown into a national high-tech innovative enterprise integrating R&D and design, manufacturing, international trade, cross-border e-commerce, technical services and global logistics. The group now covers a factory area of more than 300,000 square meters and has more than 2,000 professional employees. In October 2024, the group's intelligent manufacturing base with a total investment of 1.01 billion RMB was officially completed and put into operation in Jibei High-tech Industrial Park, comprehensively upgrading its automated production capacity, annual output value and product quality control capability. The company specializes in a full range of construction machinery, including large mining excavators, various drilling rigs, pile drivers, rotary drilling rigs, loaders, road machinery and more than 40 other product categories. It owns more than 200 independent intellectual property patents and has obtained a number of international authoritative certifications such as CE, ISO9001 and ISO45001, which can meet customs clearance and government project bidding requirements worldwide. Our products are exported to more than 180 countries and regions across Asia, Africa, Europe, South America and Central Asia. With overseas warehouses and regional after-sales service centers in key overseas markets, we provide global partners with one-stop services including OEM/ODM customization, rapid spare parts supply and on-site technical guidance. Adhering to the development philosophy of technology-driven and quality-oriented, the group is committed to providing global customers with highly reliable and cost-effective construction machinery and systematic engineering solutions.
